The catalog page is https://www.coursera.org/browse/health/psychology, and a search for “Psychology” (https://www.coursera.org/search?query=Psychology) is dominated by specializations from the American Psychological Association, University of Pennsylvania, Wesleyan, and Cambridge.

## Standout course

**Introduction to Psychology** (Yale, Paul Bloom) — https://www.coursera.org/learn/introduction-psychology

This is the category’s most popular course and a bestseller: **1,643,784** enrolled, **4.9** stars from **32,711** reviews, beginner with no prior experience required. It is about **2 weeks at 10 hours a week**, with 7 modules and 6 assignments, taught in English with 25 languages available. It covers perception, communication, learning, memory, decision-making, persuasion, emotions, and social behavior, plus how those break down with illness and injury.

| Module | Time |
|---|---|
| Welcome to Introduction to Psychology | 1 hour |
| Foundations | 4 hours |
| Development and Language | 3 hours |
| Cognition | 2 hours |
| Self and others | 3 hours |
| Variation | 3 hours |
| The good life | 1 hour |

The same page also points to intro courses from the University of Toronto and O.P. Jindal Global University.

## Two specializations opened in full

**Foundations of Positive Psychology** (University of Pennsylvania, Martin Seligman and others) — https://www.coursera.org/specializations/positivepsychology

Bestseller, **101,168** enrolled, **4.8** from **8,707** reviews, beginner, about **2 months at 10 hours a week**. Five courses: Seligman’s Visionary Science (17 hours), Applications and Interventions (13), Character, Grit and Research Methods (12), Resilience Skills (14), and a well-being project (6). Skills listed include mindfulness, stress management, resilience, and goal setting. Free enrollment is offered with a start date of Nov 8.

**Abnormal Psychology** (Wesleyan University) — https://www.coursera.org/specializations/abnormal-psychology

**28,464** enrolled, **4.8** from **776** reviews, beginner, about **4 weeks at 10 hours a week**. Three courses: Introduction to Abnormal Psychology (14 hours), History of Mental Illness (15), and Creating Behavioral Change (10). The page states it is an introduction to diagnosis, empathy, and behavior change, and is not a replacement for therapy or formal psychiatric training.

## What the search results emphasize

The first page of results is almost all specializations:

- **Clinical / disorders (APA):** Psychology of Anxiety, Mood, Substance Use, and Addictive Behaviors; Psychology of Disorders Related to Trauma, Anxiety, & Stress; Psychology of Substance Use, Depressive Disorders, & Trauma
- **Research methods (APA):** Psychological Research; Qualitative Research Methods in Psychology; Basic Inferential Statistics for Psychology; Data Exploration in Psychology
- **Other:** The Science of Mind and Decision Making (University of Cambridge); Marketing Psychology & Neuromarketing (Alex Genadinik); Psychology in the Age of GenAI (Coursera)

Suggested follow-up searches on that page: introduction to psychology, counseling, behavioral, educational, criminal, clinical, developmental, and neuroscience and psychology. Filter chips also include “Psychology Core Concepts and Disorders” and “Psychological Research and Statistical Methods.”

## Other picks on the Psychology category page

- **Most popular:** Social Psychology (Wesleyan, marked free); Psychological First Aid (Johns Hopkins)
- **Top rated:** Everyday Parenting: The ABCs of Child Rearing (Yale); Positive Psychology: Resilience Skills (Penn); Introduction to Psychology (University of Toronto, marked free)
- **Happiness:** Finding Purpose and Meaning in Life and The Science of Success (both University of Michigan)
- **Short (24 hours or less):** Moralities of Everyday Life (Yale); Positive Psychology: Applications and Interventions (Penn); Social Norms, Social Change II (Penn and UNICEF, marked free)
- **Beginner:** Introduction to Self-Determination Theory (University of Rochester); Seligman’s Visionary Science (Penn); Unethical Decision Making in Organizations (University of Lausanne, marked free)
- **Certificate in Spanish:** Primeros auxilios psicológicos, estrés y dolor crónico (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona), marked new
